cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Financial Analyst II role supporting Emergency Medicine at Mass General Brigham. The posting centers on managing expenses, reporting monthly financials and tracking clinical commitments, which is close to the work I have done for the last three years in healthcare finance.

Since August 2023 I have been the Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, where I run financial operations for a practice serving more than 1,000 patients a year. I build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts, produce budget-versus-actual variance analysis and KPI reports for ownership, and oversee pricing analysis, billing, collections and revenue tracking. By improving our financial reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix, I identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue. I also automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation with Python, cutting processing time from five hours to one and flagging underpaid claims for follow-up, and I reduced A/R aging by 10% by streamlining claim submission and follow-up.

Earlier, as a Financial Analyst Intern at Northrop Grumman, I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and presented cost-saving recommendations on pricing and budget variances to senior leadership. That work taught me to check data integrity before drawing conclusions, which your posting lists as part of the role. I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance from Brandeis and a B.S. in Business Administration with a Finance major from Suffolk. Excel is my daily tool, and I am comfortable with SQL and Tableau for reporting.

I would welcome the chance to support your financial leadership with clear variance explanations and reliable monthly reporting. Thank you for considering my application. I am available immediately and would be glad to talk through how my experience fits the team.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
